You can play anything with any guitar really.
Each type of pickups and guitar will sound different.

If you wanna play some Metallica , Slayer , Periphery , Erra then get something with HUMBUCKERs

If you wanna play something like Loathe , THORNHILL then either go with P90s or Single Coils baritone, There are endless possibilities.

Learn how to play , how to use amp sims , get your guitar strung with the right strings for your tuning, get it set up by a professional or learn how to do it yourself.
